fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Provider API key (encrypted). For AWS this is the secret access key.

fields.label: AWS
fields.description: One row per AWS account — IAM keys are account-scoped, not region-scoped. The launch defaults below apply to every Machine on this account; a Machine may override any of them.

fields.label: Access Key ID
fields.description: The secret half goes in API Key above.

fields.label: Default Region
fields.description: e.g. ap-south-1. Used when a Machine's Region has no region code.

fields.label: AMI ID
fields.description: Ubuntu image to launch. Its root volume holds the engine images and the weights.

fields.label: Default Subnet Group
fields.description: Used when a Machine has no Subnet Group linked directly.

fields.label: EC2 Key Pair
fields.description: Optional — Grove's own SSH Keys are injected via user-data regardless.

fields.label: GPU Types (raw)
fields.description: Cached provider GPU-type list; refreshed by the Fetch GPU Types button (background job).
